instruction: Sort all references in the reference list alphabetically by the first author's last name.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires sorting all references alphabetically by first author's last name. The evaluator extracts the first author from each reference (text before the first comma), then checks if the list is alphabetically sorted. Partial credit is given based on how many references are in the correct alphabetical position.

scoring_breakdown.0.0-1.0: Partial credit based on how many references are in correct alphabetical position
scoring_breakdown.1.0: All references sorted alphabetically by first author's last name

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts references from the LibreOffice Writer document by finding the 'References' section
Metric correctly checks alphabetical ordering with case-insensitive comparison
Partial credit logic appropriately scores based on number of references in correct position
Postconfig properly saves the document before verification to ensure state freshness

Citation format assumption: The metric extracts text before first comma as 'first author', which works for standard academic formats (APA/MLA: 'LastName, FirstName') but makes an implicit assumption about citation format
For typical academic essays, the implementation will work correctly as they use standard citation formats where last name comes first
